description.value: Storeys Café is a nonprofit social enterprise in Richmond where every purchase supports people in recovery from addiction as they build job skills and confidence. Located half a block from Richmond City Hall, the café offers fresh coffee, wholesome sandwiches, soups, salads, and baked goods in a relaxed, welcoming space. The menu includes vegetarian and gluten-free options alongside classic breakfast and lunch fare.
